identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of IMRT Radiotherapy Concurrent Chemothrerapy for Anal Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Phase II Study of IMRT Radiotherapy Concurrent Chemothrerapy for Anal Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and adverse events of intensity modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) concurrent with chemotherapy for anal squamous carcinoma. All enrolled anal squamous carcinoma patients are intented to receive IMRT concurrent with Capecitabine + mitomycin ± cetuximab targeted therapy.

armGroups.label: Chemo-radiotherapy with IMRT technique
armGroups.description: Radiotherapy with IMRT technique concurrent with Capecitabine and MMC chemotherapy

primaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate response rate of IMRT with chemotherapy

secondaryOutcomes.description: To assess the adverse events of IMRT with chemotherapy
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from start of IMRT to 8 weeks after IMRT
